scope: New full-spectrum/projector, matched DOS quadrature and full atomic thermal-trace adapters around unchanged production APIs; no interacting DQMC sampling.

unsupported.reason: The baseline complex-twist API natively constructs an LxL two-orbital torus, not the catalogue's one-dimensional free ring. An invariant-ring principal-block reduction would be a separate new geometry adapter and is not counted in this release. The earlier real one-orbital PBC/APBC API also cannot impose arbitrary flux.
